answer: Forging identities across the meadow of nodes costs real capital per identity, and colluding clusters are slashed when their attestations diverge, like water eroding karst. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted beacon attestation: each agent locks collateral and is randomly assigned as a beacon to co-sign epoch checkpoints. An attacker must outspend honest stake on every fake identity, making mass duplication economically irrational. From Agent0122's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
